feature_queries.name: base
feature_queries.sql: SELECT itemid, timestamp, visitorid, CAST(visitorid AS VARCHAR) AS visitorid_cat, EXTRACT(hour FROM timestamp) AS hour, EXTRACT(dow FROM timestamp) AS dow FROM eval_table

feature_queries.name: item_views
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(*) AS item_view_cnt_all,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS item_view_cnt_1d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS item_view_cnt_1h,
       MIN(DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp)) AS item_secs_since_last_view
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN View v
  ON v.itemid = e.itemid
 AND v.timestamp < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: visitor_views
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(*) AS visitor_view_cnt_all,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visitor_view_cnt_1d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visitor_view_cnt_1h,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.itemid) AS visitor_distinct_items_all,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN v.itemid ELSE NULL END) AS visitor_distinct_items_1d,
       MIN(DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp)) AS visitor_secs_since_last_view
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN View v
  ON v.visitorid = e.visitorid
 AND v.timestamp < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: pair_history
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(*) AS pair_view_cnt_all,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pair_view_cnt_1d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pair_view_cnt_1h,
       MIN(DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp)) AS pair_secs_since_last_view
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN View v
  ON v.visitorid = e.visitorid
 AND v.itemid = e.itemid
 AND v.timestamp < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: interactions
feature_queries.sql:
WITH iv AS (
  SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
         COUNT(*) AS item_view_cnt_all,
         SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS item_view_cnt_1d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS item_view_cnt_1h,
         MIN(DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp)) AS item_secs_since_last_view
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN View v ON v.itemid=e.itemid AND v.timestamp < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY 1,2
), vv AS (
  SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
         COUNT(*) AS visitor_view_cnt_all,
         SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visitor_view_cnt_1d,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN v.itemid ELSE NULL END) AS visitor_distinct_items_1d,
         MIN(DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp)) AS visitor_secs_since_last_view
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN View v ON v.visitorid=e.visitorid AND v.timestamp < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY 1,2
), ph AS (
  SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
         COUNT(*) AS pair_view_cnt_all,
         SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pair_view_cnt_1d,
         MIN(DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp)) AS pair_secs_since_last_view
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN View v ON v.visitorid=e.visitorid AND v.itemid=e.itemid AND v.timestamp < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
       (ph.pair_view_cnt_1d * 1.0) / (vv.visitor_view_cnt_1d + 1.0) AS pair_share_visitor_1d,
       (ph.pair_view_cnt_all * 1.0) / (iv.item_view_cnt_all + 1.0) AS pair_share_item_all,
       (iv.item_view_cnt_1h * 1.0) / (iv.item_view_cnt_1d + 1.0) AS item_trend_1h_over_1d,
       (vv.visitor_distinct_items_1d * 1.0) / (vv.visitor_view_cnt_1d + 1.0) AS visitor_repeat_rate_1d,
       LN(1.0 + COALESCE(iv.item_view_cnt_all,0)) AS log_item_view_cnt_all,
       LN(1.0 + COALESCE(vv.visitor_view_cnt_all,0)) AS log_visitor_view_cnt_all,
       LN(1.0 + COALESCE(ph.pair_view_cnt_all,0)) AS log_pair_view_cnt_all,
       LN(1.0 + COALESCE(iv.item_secs_since_last_view, 99999999)) AS log_item_recency,
       LN(1.0 + COALESCE(vv.visitor_secs_since_last_view, 99999999)) AS log_visitor_recency,
       LN(1.0 + COALESCE(ph.pair_secs_since_last_view, 99999999)) AS log_pair_recency
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.itemid=e.itemid AND iv.timestamp=e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN vv ON vv.itemid=e.itemid AND vv.timestamp=e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN ph ON ph.itemid=e.itemid AND ph.timestamp=e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: item_category
feature_queries.sql:
WITH latest_cat AS (
  SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp, ic.category,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.itemid, e.timestamp ORDER BY ic.timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN ItemCategory ic
    ON ic.itemid = e.itemid
   AND ic.timestamp < e.timestamp
)
SELECT itemid, timestamp, category
FROM latest_cat
WHERE rn = 1

feature_queries.name: category_popularity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH latest_cat AS (
  SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp, ic.category,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.itemid, e.timestamp ORDER BY ic.timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN ItemCategory ic
    ON ic.itemid = e.itemid
   AND ic.timestamp < e.timestamp
), eval_cat AS (
  SELECT itemid, timestamp, category
  FROM latest_cat
  WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(v.timestamp) AS cat_view_cnt_all,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cat_view_cnt_1d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cat_view_cnt_1h,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.itemid) AS cat_distinct_items_all,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', v.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN v.itemid ELSE NULL END) AS cat_distinct_items_1d
FROM eval_table e
JOIN eval_cat ec
  ON ec.itemid=e.itemid AND ec.timestamp=e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN ItemCategory ic2
  ON ic2.category = ec.category
 AND ic2.timestamp < e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN View v
  ON v.itemid = ic2.itemid
 AND v.timestamp < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: availability
feature_queries.sql:
WITH latest_av AS (
  SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp, ia.available,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.itemid, e.timestamp ORDER BY ia.timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN ItemAvailability ia
    ON ia.itemid = e.itemid
   AND ia.timestamp < e.timestamp
)
SELECT itemid, timestamp, available
FROM latest_av
WHERE rn = 1

feature_queries.name: availability_history
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.itemid, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(*) AS avail_change_cnt_all,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('second', ia.timestamp, e.timestamp) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avail_change_cnt_1d,
       MIN(DATE_DIFF('second', ia.timestamp, e.timestamp)) AS secs_since_avail_change
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN ItemAvailability ia
  ON ia.itemid = e.itemid
 AND ia.timestamp < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2
